title: Expose citation-refused evaluator submissions to the requester without treating them as recorded evaluations
outcome: A requester can inspect the evaluator's complete bounded submitted verdicts and the confirmed citation refusal, independently of the evaluator's final prose, and can distinguish that refused attempt from a recorded evaluation or an unknown write outcome.
acceptance: The diagnosis of evaluator session-16236 records whether the context-only marker survived into its provider-runtime input, identifies the submitted forbidden citation and the host retention/exposure path, and states the limits of the available delivery evidence without assuming that the marker was absent.

After a confirmed citation refusal, the requester can retrieve a durable, bounded structured view of the submitted criterion positions, verdicts, bases, rationales and citation locators, linked to the evaluator attempt key, judged acceptance/evidence cuts and refusal reason, explicitly marked refused and not recorded; this view survives restart and later attempts, exposes no host-private command or connection arguments, and grants no acceptance credit.

Regression coverage exercises a context-only citation refusal using Engram's exact refusal contract, checks the requester-visible refused submission and restart/later-attempt retention, and preserves the existing distinction between confirmed refusal, recorded receipt and unknown write outcome. A same-attempt repair is offered only when the tracker supplies typed citable alternatives and permits its bounded retry; otherwise a new judgment requires an explicitly requested fresh host-authored brief and key. No citation is silently removed or relabelled.

completion.summary: Requester-visible confirmed refused evaluator judgments are durably retained as a bounded safe structured view, separate from recorded receipt and unknown write custody; landed with behavioral regression coverage.
